capabilities: Start and stop Happy Squid tasks from checkboxes or strikethrough in notes
Send up to twenty unfinished subtasks and note context with each task
Insert Task Goal and Daily Summary cards into journal notes
Show daily figures like task time, Free Time and times blocked via text markers
Resolve day markers in daily-note templates for a specific date
disambiguation: Not a standalone task manager; it only bridges checkboxes and day figures to the Happy Squid app and requires it for the task features.
extras: Freemium: one task per week is free and unlimited tasks need Pro. A Supabase backend receives task text, note context and subtasks; no analytics. Full documentation lives at happy-squid.com/documentation, not in the README.
problem: Obsidian checkboxes cannot control tasks in an outside task/focus app, and task data such as time spent, blocks and streaks is not available inside notes.

relations.evidence: Keep a Happy Squid app or browser extension running to handle the request.

requires.name: Happy Squid app or browser extension
Happy Squid Pro for unlimited tasks

summary: Integration that starts and stops Happy Squid tasks from note checkboxes and inserts task goals, daily summaries and focus figures into notes.
